title: North Sea ICES model validation draft
comparison_intro: Both candidates now have convergent, finite, nonnegative results in all three reviewed formulations. ICES represents more of the North Sea, while the corrected Scotland variant has fewer diagnostic warnings and a signed researcher review. Their settings and runtime assumptions differ, so the diagnostic grades alone do not establish which model is preferable. The ICES mapping below is a proposal for review; the existing selection is not a new joint choice.
comparison_rows: Spatial and temporal fit
1991; approximately 87% of LME_022 covered by the declared ICES domain. Applying it to 2019 catch transfers a 28-year-old baseline.
1991–1995; approximately 37–42% of LME_022 covered. The Scottish shelf/fleet domain is narrower than the regional catch universe.
Source and runtime assumptions
69 ecological groups. Deposited Rpath port differs from the unavailable native Key Run. Source parameters retained; EE floor 0.1 and effective detritus stock residuals remain runtime assumptions.

25 ecological groups. Source JSON retained. Authorized derived variant removes only seabird self-feeding, redistributes the remaining prey and recomputes 13 proven loader-derived biomass-accumulation entries. Source landings exclude discards.

Corrected variant: OK; no negative or nonfinite source–group entries. rho_living = 0.21209. Both strict balance checks pass.

Corrected variant: WARN; rho_living = 0.27574. No negative or nonfinite entries; both strict balance checks pass. Near-zero TE remains for Seabirds, Seals and Cetaceans.

Ido Carmel signed MODEL VALIDATED on 14/11/2026. Groups removed from calculation: Seabirds, Seals, Cetaceans. Exact reason: All due to GE<0.01.
comparison_note: Scotland's corrected diagnostics use the pinned historical engine with the EE floor OFF and retain every group; they precede the signed exclusions. ICES uses the repaired engine with the EE floor ON at 0.1. The Scotland signature does not show that those groups were deleted from the trophic network or that saved coefficients changed. Broader geography, source fidelity, sensitivity and mapping confidence should be weighed together after this ICES review.

Both strict balance checks pass for all three methods. All three runs use EE floor 0.1: a hypothetical external nonfishery sink of 1.9837 t/km²/year across eight living groups. Source BA remains zero; effective detritus stock residuals are DOM 152.69, POM 125.21 and Discards 0.003590 t/km²/year. This runtime closure and detritus EE = 1 convention are not observed accumulation or recovered native export. No diet normalization, pooling or open-detritus adjustment was used.
